description: A recording of a DJ set, kept in the DJ's own repo.

main.description: One per set whose recording the DJ uploaded to their own account, under the set's record key. The set's recording field points at it.

audio.description: The recording, in a format browsers play: AAC in an M4A file, or MP3. video/mp4 is accepted too because a data server names a blob's type from its contents, and an MP4 file that doesn't say it's audio reads as video.

durationSeconds.description: How long it plays, in whole seconds.
